title: DecisionDebt | Ask the Company Graph | 4K Addendum | Graph Hacks Track 03
description:
Know what a decision breaks before you make it.
Track 03: Company Brain — WeMakeDevs x FalkorDB Graph Hacks.

Live read-only demo: https://decisiondebt.52.202.25.181.sslip.io/
Repository: https://github.com/himanshu748/decisiondebt
Main demo, unchanged (2:57): https://youtu.be/_a0vrYwOlME
Ask graph templates: https://github.com/himanshu748/decisiondebt/blob/main/backend/app/graph/ask_queries.py

A 58.2-second addendum recorded from the live site at 3840×2160 and 30 fps, with digital close-ups and Deepgram AI narration (Aura 2 Thalia). All Aster Works records are synthetic.

It shows: Who owns Billing API?; What would replacing Auth Gateway affect?; the typo Biling API offering Billing API as a suggestion; an unsupported question rejected without a query; and the real client-side Markdown ticket export. Cypher, parameters, row counts, query timings and exact source spans appear on screen. The public graph stayed at revision 16.

Public questions use deterministic intent matching and fixed parameterized read-only Cypher through GRAPH.RO_QUERY. No model is called and no provider key is exposed. A previously recorded genuine provider investigation is available in the main demo and repository. Approval workflows require the protected local setup; this addendum performs reads and a client-side export only.

Chapters
00:00 Live cited question and executed Cypher
00:12 Bounded impact, suggestions and unsupported questions
00:43 Markdown ticket export

AI disclosure: The participant originated the core idea and directed the UI; AI expanded the specification. Codex generated most of the implementation, tests and styling, plus the recording and editing automation. Deepgram generated the narration. These automated recording actions are not attributed to the participant as personal verification.

The existing main video and all earlier evidence are preserved unchanged. The recording manifest, exact answers, speech checks and upload receipt are in evidence/ask-addendum-20261017 on the addendum branch.
